domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including whole numbers), with regrouping and simplification

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common (often least) denominator and rewrite one or both fractions (or fractional parts of mixed numbers) as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Explicitly determines an LCD/LCM or otherwise chooses a common denominator for two fractions
Converts one or more fractions to equivalent forms with the shared denominator prior to subtraction (including converting only the fractional parts of mixed numbers)
exclusion_criteria: Denominators already match and no conversion is performed
Only reduces/simplifies a fraction without the goal of matching another fraction’s denominator

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once denominators match by subtracting numerators while keeping the common denominator (including intermediate zero or negative fractional results).
inclusion_criteria: Computes x/d − y/d = (x−y)/d (or equivalent) after denominators are the same
Subtracts fractional parts within a mixed-number subtraction when the fractional denominators match
Produces intermediate results such as 0/d or a negative fraction prior to any regrouping
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD/converts fractions but does not execute the subtraction
Only performs borrowing/regrouping or final simplification/formatting without doing the numerator subtraction step

skills.name: Rewrite mixed/whole forms
skills.definition: Rewrite whole numbers and mixed numbers into a subtraction-ready representation (e.g., separate whole and fractional parts, convert mixed to improper, or express a whole number with a chosen denominator).
inclusion_criteria: Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0/d or as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator
Converts a mixed number (including one with an improper fractional part) to an improper fraction or otherwise restructures terms to enable subtraction
Simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number as a preparatory rewrite (e.g., 4/10 → 2/5) before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Straight subtraction where all quantities are already in compatible forms and no representation change is made
Borrowing/regrouping after discovering a negative fractional part (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow/regroup between whole and fractional parts to resolve a negative fractional difference, then express the final answer in simplest appropriate form (reduce and/or convert to integer or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows 1 from the whole part and adds an equivalent 1 (d/d) to the fractional part to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative
Reduces/simplifies the resulting fraction (including turning 0/d into 0) as part of finishing
Converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number or integer as the final expression
exclusion_criteria: Only performs the raw fraction subtraction with no regrouping and no final-form simplification/conversion shown
Only finds LCD/converts denominators (S01) or only rewrites inputs (S03) without any regrouping/finalization
